g.title: Spring Boot application · one JVM Deployment boundary: one Maven-built Java 25 process. All internal arrows are in-process calls or port implementations.
Controllers Package grouping. Two delivery adapters, same core contracts.

Household browser Spanish pages + htmx fragments. Member and admin UI. Session cookie + CSRF.

text.tspan: and admin UI. Session cookie + CSRF.

g.title: iPhone app SwiftUI on each iPhone. URLSession REST; hs_sess_ token in Keychain.
Local agent clients Claude Code / Codex. hs_key_ in environment; queries and grocery additions.
Local DNS Router resolver: home-companion.home.arpa → reserved LAN IP. Same name for every client.

text.tspan: LAN IP. Same name for every client.

g.title: Caddy · LAN HTTPS 443 entry point; 80 redirects. Internal CA and automatic renewal. Proxy to app:8080; block Actuator.
Certificate volume caddy_data persists CA keys and certificates. Distribute public root only; clients validate chain + DNS SAN.
Security SecurityConfig; CredentialFilter; RequestAuthorization. RequestActorResolver.resolve(request): Actor. Fresh Accounts verdict on every request.
Web Adapter GroceryWebController(queries, commands). stock(actor): View; add(actor, form): redirect / fragment. Auth, accounts, admin, images.
Phone API GroceryApiController(queries, commands). stock(actor): DTO; add(actor, request): result. Auth, features, accounts, images.
Agent Tools GroceryTools(queries, commands). 3 list tools + groceries_add_stock. Stateless HTTP; READ_WRITE and owner EDIT for additions.

text.tspan: READ_WRITE and owner EDIT for additions.

g.title: Accounts and Access CredentialService(repository, hasher). resolve(token); PermissionEvaluator.effective(credential,module). Accounts, grants, keys, module catalogue.
Groceries GroceryQueries / GroceryCommands(repository, imageStore). addStock(actor, command). ShoppingListCalculator: needed=max(0,target−stock).
Shared contracts Actor(userId,credentialId,permission); TokenHasher; ImageStore port; ImageRef. No dependency on adapters or other core modules.

text.tspan: dependency on adapters or other core modules.

g.title: Infrastructure adapters JpaAccountRepository; JpaGroceryRepository; LocalImageStore. Implements core ports; transactions, parameterized SQL and image re-encoding.
PostgreSQL 18 pgdata volume. Accounts, grants, hashed credentials, current groceries and 24 h request deduplication. No public port.
Image files icons volume. Validated PNG / JPEG output; PNG, JPEG and still WebP input. LocalImageStore owns filesystem access.

text.tspan: icons volume. Validated PNG / JPEG output;
PNG, JPEG and still WebP input.

No backups, HA or action history.
